item.title: PIF-backed startup raises $40 million for AI construction monitoring in Riyadh
item.description: The company uses computer vision to compare site progress against BIM models, automating progress tracking for contractors. The round values the company at $180 million.

item.title: Reality capture and digital twin adoption accelerates among large contractors
item.description: Laser scanning and drone inspection are moving from pilot projects to standard practice, with measurable productivity gains reported on large infrastructure works.

item.title: Construction robotics vendor signs deal with major contractor for automated layout
item.description: The deal covers automated layout and quantity takeoff across twelve active projects.
